entities.summary: Saeed Soltanpour was an Iranian poet, playwright, and theater director who was deeply involved in left-wing politics and a member of the Iranian Writers Association. He was executed on July 26, 1981, by the Islamic Republic authorities during the 1981–1982 Iran Massacres.
